principle: One successful mainline with direction/scenario-scoped experts. Independently confirmed experts are routed, not silently score-fused.

production_default.rule: use r2e_enzgfm_center_full_clean2023 iff max_train_binary_drfp_tanimoto < 0.9; otherwise r2e_center_bounded_cap0p1_full_clean2023

experts.name: r2e_enzgfm_center_full_clean2023
experts.role: confirmed low-reaction-similarity R2E expert; selected only below frozen binary-DRFP threshold 0.9

validated_refinements.name: r2e_top2000_high_similarity_router
validated_refinements.rule: use pair residual scale 0.03 iff max_train_drfp_tanimoto >= 0.9; otherwise exact coarse fallback
validated_refinements.note: Validated as a precision refinement; not claimed as an already-tested score fusion with the bounded-center production checkpoint.

validated_refinements.name: r2e_fast_similarity_model_router_v1
validated_refinements.note: Two internal development salts agreed; a separate untouched fold6 passed every frozen primary/non-regression check. No outer benchmark selected the rule.

router.selection_data: Two clean internal development salts selected one simple threshold; one separately frozen fold6 confirmation validated it. External/revealed benchmark labels never chose model or threshold.
router.policy: For eligible general_merged external R2E direct queries, select between the two independently full-clean packaged checkpoints using train-only binary-DRFP similarity <0.9. Preserve legacy v2 deployments outside that evidence scope.

scenario_routing.evidence: two internal development salts plus untouched fold6 confirmation

explicit_nonclaims: The unconditional all-query EnzGFM/equal-block + bounded-center comprehensive candidate failed its earlier material-gain gate. That historical rejection remains valid; a later independently preregistered R2E-only similarity-conditioned route (<0.9) passed a separate untouched confirmation and is promoted only in that narrower scope.

The fixed Top-2000 pair residual was jointly tested over bounded-center on a fresh preregistered development protocol and rejected; it remains independently confirmed but is not fused into the production route.
No post-hoc reuse of Enzyme-405, ReactZyme, temporal or Rhea128->141 labels for V3 model selection.

rejected_integrations.name: comprehensive_directional_center_v1
rejected_integrations.reason: All safety/stability floors passed, but neither direction reached the predeclared +0.01 MRR/MAP or +2pp Hit@10 material-gain threshold.

rejected_integrations.name: comprehensive_center_top2000_v1
